message.content:
**Decision: bought a small position.**

**What the research showed.** The only substantive sources I could verify were Home Depot's own newsroom release and the matching Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR, and they agree with each other. Home Depot labels its fiscal year ended 2024-01-28 as "fiscal 2024": TTM net sales of **$152,669M**, operating income **$21,689M**, net income **$15,143M**, diluted EPS **$15.11**, and operating cash flow **$21,172M**. Versus the prior year (FYE Jan-2023): sales $157,403M, operating income $24,039M, net income $17,105M, EPS $16.69 — i.e., sales −3.0%, operating income −9.8%, net income −11.5%, EPS −9.5%. I deliberately discarded one search hit (fin-data-live.net) that asserted "corrected" fiscal 2024 net sales of $352.9 billion — that's roughly 2.3x the audited figure, contradicts both the company release and the 10-K, and would make HD larger than Walmart; it is not usable data. The "news roundup" pages returned no usable content, and nothing in the verified set pointed to a specific negative catalyst.

**What I did and why.** With HD at $385.43 / $385.45 (bid/ask, 15:05Z on 2024-11-06), I placed one limit buy for **12 shares at $386.00**, which filled at $386.00 — about **$4,632**, inside the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily caps and at a price only ~0.15% above the ask, so it's "close to market." The rationale: HD is a high-quality franchise generating $21.2B of operating cash flow, and the stock at ~25.5x trailing EPS ($385.43 ÷ $15.11) already discounts a fair amount of the housing/DIY slump shown in the declining comps and earnings. But those declining margins and the fact that Q3 results land in about a week (mid-November) are real risks, so I sized it as a modest starter (12 shares, ~4.6% of the $100k cash balance) rather than a full $5,000 position — a buy supported by the reported $152.7B revenue / $15.11 diluted EPS / $21.2B operating cash flow base, with the -3% sales and -11% net income trend being the reason I kept it small. No other orders were placed and no funds were moved out of the account.
